newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest estimates cut.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc on Monday said it lowered its second-quarter and 1997 earnings estimates for Northwest Airlines Corp because of the yen's weakness and the airline's labor expenses.
-- Still, the firm kept its outperform rating on the stock.

-- Dillon, Read analyst Edward Starkman said in a research note he reduced his second-quarter earnings projection to $1.05 per share on a fully diluted basis from $1.65 and his 1997 estimate to $4.45 from $5.30.

-- "The company will report two types of yen-related earnings shortfalls in the second quarter," he said. "There will be a below-the-line exchange loss of about $20 million plus and additional yen weakness continues to negatively impact Northwest's heavily Japan-dependent Pacific division."
-- Labor expenses and higher wages would also hurt the airline's second-quarter results, he said.
-- Northwest shares were trading off 3/4 at 39-1/4 early Monday afternoon.
--Earlier, the airline reported its May passenger load factor rose to 74.8 percent from 73.8 percent.
